feat->Research Field.name: Campo De Investigacion
feat->Research Field.description:
Tu inquiries into the alchemical NATURE of the universe have led tu to focus on a particular field of research. Tú might have a degree from a scientific institute, correspond with other researchers in tu field, or work as a genius loner. Elige a field of research.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of infused reagents to create tu signature items using advanced alchemy, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

feat->Alchemy.name: Alquimia
feat->Alchemy.description:
Tú understand the complex interactions of natural and unnatural substances and can concoct alchemical items to meet tu needs. Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use special infused reagents that allow tu to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tu advance in power dramaticaliado, leaving behind those who no understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, even if tu no meet that feat's prerequisites, and obtienes the four common 1st-level alchemical formulas granted by that feat. Puedes use this feat to create alchemical items as long as tienes the items' formulas in tu formula book.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item they can create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book (Blank)} worth 10 sp or less for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to those tu gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automaticamente, but it's also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to invent them with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent alchemical reactions. Tú start with the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical bombs, in addition to tu other formulas.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents} to create tu signature items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy}, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes deal dano de salpicadura to only tu primary target instead of the usual splash area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery}Level 5

When using Advanced Alchemy to make bombs during tu daily preparations, puedes use a batch of reagents to create any three bombs instead of just two of the same bomb.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DFQDtT1Van4fFEHi]{Perpetual Infusions}Level 7

Tienes learned how to create perpetual alchemical infusions that can provide a near-infinite supply of certain simple items. Obtienes the ability to create two 1st-level alchemical items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} without spending a batch of infused reagents. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap any number of tu perpetual infusions with other eligible infusions.

Elige two 1st-level bombs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8rEVg03QJ71ic3PP]{Perpetual Potency}Level 11

Tu perpetual infusions improve, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create more powerful items with no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The moderate versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RGs4uR3CAvgbtBAA]{Greater Field Discovery}Level 13

Puedes increase the splash on tu bombs to dano criaturas within 10 pies, or 15 pies if tienes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.xO90iBD8XNGyaCkz]{Perpetual Perfection}Level 17

Tienes perfected tu perpetual infusions, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create even more powerful items at no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The greater versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

0.text: Puedes deal dano de salpicadura to only tu primary target instead of the usual splash area.

feat->Infused Reagents.name: Reactivos Infundidos
feat->Infused Reagents.description:
Tú infuse reagents with tu own alchemical essence, allowing tu to create alchemical items at no cost. Each day during tu daily preparations, obtienes a number of batches of infused reagents equal to tu level + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Puedes use these reagents for either advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy, described below. Together, these infused reagents have light Volumen.

As soon as tu make tu next daily preparations, tu infused reagents from the previous day's preparations are instantly destroyed, and nonpermanent effects of tu previous day's infused items immediately end. While infused reagents are physical objects, they no puede be duplicated, preserved, or created in any way other than tu daily preparations. Any such artificial reagents lack the infusion and are useless for advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, after producing new @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents}, puedes spend batches of those infused reagents to create infused alchemical items.

Tú no need to intentar una CRAFTING check to do this, and tu ignore both the number of days normalmente required to create the items and any alchemical reagent requirements.

Tu advanced alchemy level is equal to tu level. For each batch of infused reagents tu spend, elige an alchemical item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book, and make a batch of two of that item.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent durante 24 horas or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

action->Quick Alchemy.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]

Requisitos Tienes the formula for the alchemical item estás creating, and estás either holding or wearing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.4ftXXUCBHcf4b0MH]{alchemist's Toolkit}.

Tú swiftly mix up a short-lived alchemical item to use at a moment's notice. Creas a single alchemical consumable item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book without having to spend the normal monetary cost in alchemical reagents or needing to intentar una CRAFTING check. Este item has the infused rasgo, but it remains potent only until el comienzo de tu siguiente turno.

feat->Quick Alchemy.description: If necesitas a specific alchemical item on the fly, puedes use tu infused reagents to quickly create it with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} action.

backpack->Bag of Holding (Type II).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JBMBaN9dZLytfFLQ]

Aunque parece un saco de tela decorado con paneles de seda de colores vivos o bordados elegantes, una bolsa de contencion se abre a un espacio extradimensional mayor que sus dimensiones exteriores. El Volumen guardado dentro de la bolsa no cambia el Volumen de la propia bolsa de contencion. La cantidad de Volumen que puede contener el espacio extradimensional de la bolsa depende de su tipo.

Puedes Interactuar con la bolsa de contencion para meter o sacar objetos igual que con un saco corriente. Aunque la bolsa puede contener una gran cantidad de material, un objeto aun debe caber por la abertura del saco para poder guardarse en su interior.

Si la bolsa se sobrecarga o se rompe, se rasga y queda arruinada, haciendo que los objetos de su interior se pierdan para siempre. Si se le da la vuelta, los objetos de su interior se derraman sin sufrir danos, pero la bolsa debe volver a ponerse correctamente antes de poder usarse de nuevo. Una criatura viva colocada dentro de la bolsa tiene aire suficiente para 10 minutos antes de empezar a asfixiarse, y puede intentar Escapar contra una CD 13. Un objeto dentro de la bolsa no proporciona beneficios salvo que se recupere primero. Un objeto en la bolsa no puede ser detectado por magia que solo detecte cosas en el mismo plano.

Capacidad 50 Volumen

feat->Specialty Crafting (Alchemy).description:
Tu training focused on CRAFTING one particular kind of item. Obtienes a +1 bonificador por circunstancia to CRAFTING checks to Craft alchemical items. If estás a maestro in CRAFTING, this bonus increases to +2.

Sample Items Alchemical Items such as Elixirs

If it's unclear whether the specialty applies, the GM decides. Some specialties might apply only partialiado. For example, if tu were making a morningstar and had specialty in woodworking, the GM might give tu half tu bonus because the item requires both blacksmithing and woodworking.

spell->Produce Flame.name: Producir llama
spell->Produce Flame.description:
Una pequena esfera de llamas aparece en la palma de tu mano, y la arrojas cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia. Haz una tirada de ataque de conjuro contra la CA de tu objetivo. Normalmente es un ataque a distancia, pero tambien puedes hacer un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo contra una criatura dentro de tu alcance sin armas.

Con un exito, infliges 2d4 de dano de fuego. Con un exito critico, el objetivo sufre el doble de dano y @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] de dano persistente de fuego.

Intensificado (+1) Aumenta el dano en 1d4 y el dano persistente de un impacto critico en 1d4.

Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use special infused reagents that allow tu to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tu advance in power dramaticaliado, leaving behind those who no understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, even if tu no meet that feat's prerequisites, and obtienes the four common 1st-level alchemical formulas granted by that feat. Puedes use this feat to create alchemical items as long as tienes the items' formulas in tu formula book.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item they can create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book (Blank)} worth 10 sp or less for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to those tu gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automaticamente, but it's also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to invent them with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat.

feat->Field Discovery.name: Descubrimiento de campo
feat->Field Discovery.description: Aprendes a special discovery depending on tu field.

feat->Powerful Alchemy.name: Alquimia poderosa
feat->Powerful Alchemy.description: Alchemical items tu create on the fly are particularly potent. When tu use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} to create an infused alchemical item that allows a tirada de salvacion, puedes change its DC to tu CLASS DC.

feat->Alchemical Weapon Expertise.name: Experiencia Con Las Armas Alquímicas
feat->Alchemical Weapon Expertise.description: Te has entrenado para blandir con mas eficacia las armas que encuentras en tu laboratorio. Tus rangos de competencia con armas sencillas, ataques sin armas y bombas alquimicas aumentan a experto.

feat->Perpetual Infusions.name: Infusiones Perpetuas
feat->Perpetual Infusions.description:
Tienes learned how to create perpetual alchemical infusions that can provide a near-infinite supply of certain simple items.

Obtienes the ability to create two 1st-level alchemical items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} without spending a batch of infused reagents. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap any number of tu perpetual infusions with other eligible infusions.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent alchemical reactions. Tú start with the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical bombs, in addition to tu other formulas.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents} to create tu signature items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy}, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes deal dano de salpicadura to only tu primary target instead of the usual splash area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery}Level 5

feat->Infused Reagents.name: Reactivos Infundidos
feat->Infused Reagents.description:
Tú infuse reagents with tu own alchemical essence, allowing tu to create alchemical items at no cost. Each day during tu daily preparations, obtienes a number of batches of infused reagents equal to tu level + tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Puedes use these reagents for either advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy, described below. Together, these infused reagents have light Volumen.

As soon as tu make tu next daily preparations, tu infused reagents from the previous day's preparations are instantly destroyed, and nonpermanent effects of tu previous day's infused items immediately end. While infused reagents are physical objects, they no puede be duplicated, preserved, or created in any way other than tu daily preparations. Any such artificial reagents lack the infusion and are useless for advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, after producing new @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents}, puedes spend batches of those infused reagents to create infused alchemical items.

Tú no need to intentar una CRAFTING check to do this, and tu ignore both the number of days normalmente required to create the items and any alchemical reagent requirements.

Tu advanced alchemy level is equal to tu level. For each batch of infused reagents tu spend, elige an alchemical item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book, and make a batch of two of that item.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent durante 24 horas or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

Kargstaad.name: Kargstaad
Kargstaad.publicNotes:
Frost giants are remorseless marauders who pillage and plunder from those who dare to live near them in desolate, frigid lands. Their clans range from extremely territorial hunters who claim an expanse of tundra and defend it at all costs to nomadic hordes that roam icy slopes in search of settlements to conquer. Frost giant clans are ruled by those who exhibit the greatest ferocity and prowess in battle-massive brutes who proclaim themselves jarl and demand absolute obedience from their followers. If at any time a frost giant wishes to be a jarl, all they must do is issue a challenge to the current jarl and face off in mortal combat, after which the reigning champion continues leading the clan or the victorious challenger assumes control.

Frost giants live in frostbitten realms, and their appearance is reflective of a people weathered and hardened by relentless snowstorms and freezing temperatures. They often wear metal armor adorned with the furs, skin, teeth, and tusks of slain beasts and heft armas as long as dining tables. Their flesh ranges from pale blue to shale gray, and their hair is normalmente a dingy white or dirty yellow color.

A typical frost giant stands about 15 pies tall and weighs approximately 2,800 pounds.

Giants are massive humanoid criaturas who live in remote regions throughout the world. They are divided into a number of subtypes.

Una criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} and takes @Damage[2d6[cold]] dano at el final de each of its turns until it gets free (Escape DC 41).

Leng Envoy.name: Leng Envoy
Leng Envoy.publicNotes:
Slavers and raiders from the cold, windswept dimension of Leng, these malevolent humanoids range across reality in ominous black ships capable of sailing beyond the borders of dimensions and planes. Although most denizens of Leng seek slaves and plunder like any pirate, others operate as self-styled ambassadors and merchants, sowing discord with far-ranging plots. While the inscrutable denizens dress themselves in flowing robes, veils, and broad turbans to appear human, their aberrant physiology, when glimpsed, is evident from their crown of stubby horns and tentacled jaws to their furry, goat-like legs.

Above the fierce captains who command the infamous black ships are an even higher caste of denizens of Leng. Estos cultists and musicians serve as high priests, laboring to appease the frightening gods who look down upon the Nightmare Realm with cold malice.

Lesser Jabberwock.name: Lesser Jabberwock
Lesser Jabberwock.publicNotes:
Few beasts have inspired as many legends, poems, songs, and myths in as many cultures, as this bizarre draconic criatura. The jabberwock hails from the fey realm of the First World and is part of a group of powerful First World criaturas known collectively as the Tane.

Like all members of the Tane, jabberwocks are criaturas vivas that age, eat, drink, and sleep, but do not reproduce normalmente. Instead, they are created directly by the godlike Eldest who rule the First World, and they serve at the pleasure of these capricious and mysterious entities. Believed to be the most powerful of all the Tane, jabberwocks are normalmente only ever created with one purpose: to wreak destruction and havoc upon the Material Plane. One of the Eldest might send a jabberwock to devastate a country, continent, or even entire world in order to get revenge for some slight made against them by a single mortal. Sometimes, no specific insult or injury is required, as some of the Eldest resent the very existence of the Material Plane and periodicamente create jabberwocks simply to express the wrath of the First World against its younger and less chaotic sibling.

Once a jabberwock arrives on the Material Plane, its first order of business is to seek out a lair. It prefers dwelling in remote forest locations about a day's flight from civilization-the more dangerous the woodland is to those who might eventualiado come hunting it, the better!

The relationship between jabberwocks and vorpal armas is the subject of much debate and speculation among scholars, and the various poems, songs, and legends about the jabberwock do little to clarify the issue, conflicting and diverging on this point. Some believe that vorpal armas were first created specificaliado to combat jabberwocks, but others take the story one step further. They cite evidence in certain ancient myths that there may once have been only a single, unique jabberwock, so powerful that nothing could so much as scratch it-nothing, that is, except for the first vorpal sword, crafted for that very purpose. So epic was the resulting battle that it created strange echoes throughout reality, and as a result, these echoes, in the form of vorpal armas, can now be found on many worlds. Those who subscribe to this belief claim that the jabberwocks seen today are but pale imitations of this proto-jabberwock, and they speculate that only the combined efforts of several Eldest would be sufficient to create such una criatura again.

Variant JabberwocksThe Eldest have sometimes altered certain aspects of the jabberwocks they create. Some of the more notorious or legendario variant jabberwocks include the following.

Frumious Jabberwock: Frumious jabberwocks have two heads. They are level 24 and gain an extra action on each of their turns they can use only to make a jaws Golpe.

Mimsy Jabberwock: Typicaliado hailing from wintry regions of the First World, mimsy jabberwocks have glowing blue-white scales, resist cold instead of fire, and have eyes that burn with blue flames that deal dano de frío instead of dano de fuego.

Slithy Jabberwock: Wreaking destruction beneath the waves, these sinuous and slimy jabberwocks are amphibious, have a swim Velocidad of 80 pies instead of the normal fly Velocidad, and do not have a wing Golpe. A slithy jabberwock's whiffling aura is activated siempre que it swims, makes a tail Golpe, or Burbles.

Lintwerth.name: Lintwerth
Lintwerth.publicNotes:
Whining and self-important criaturas, dust mephits are known for their tendency to pronounce doom and gloom at every opportunity, lamenting every insignificant and minor difficulty as though it were an insurmountable obstacle and making themselves out to be heroes for struggling valiantly against their cruel fates. They tend to be thin and gaunt, with dusky brown and gray skin and wings.

Mephits are small, weak criaturas that serve at the whims of other elemental entities. The mephits presented here are less common than air mephits, earth mephits, and the like, as they are a blfinal de two different elements rather than focusing on one alone.

feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Composition Spells

Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tu to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tu start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutos using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automaticamente heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros no require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tu more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that no cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tu like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tu elige from the occult list. Genereunido, only feats can give tu more composition cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tu swap out the specific feat via retraining. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu aliados' attacks, dano, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes normalmente play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as it takes at least one of tu hands to do so. If tu use an instrument, tu no need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes normalmente also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tu learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemigos roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvacion). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).name: Repertorio de conjuros (bardo)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tu learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult conjuro list, or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tu increase in level. Each time tu get a conjuro slot, tu add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tu select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tu select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tu add conjuros, tu might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tu already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tu another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tu might want to replace some of the conjuros tu previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

If tu muse is una criatura, it might be a dragon or otherworldly being; if a deity, it might be Irori or Nethys. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uVXEZblPRuCyPRua]{Bardic LORE} feat and add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} to tu conjuro repertoire.

Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tu start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutos using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automaticamente heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros no require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tu more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that no cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tu like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tu elige from the occult list. Genereunido, only feats can give tu more composition cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tu swap out the specific feat via retraining. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu aliados' attacks, dano, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes normalmente play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as it takes at least one of tu hands to do so. If tu use an instrument, tu no need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes normalmente also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tu learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemigos roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvacion). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).name: Repertorio de conjuros (bardo)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tu learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult conjuro list, or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tu increase in level. Each time tu get a conjuro slot, tu add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tu select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tu select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tu add conjuros, tu might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tu already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tu another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tu might want to replace some of the conjuros tu previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Lightning Reflexes.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TUOeATt52P43r5W0]
Lightning Reflexes
feat->Lightning Reflexes.description: Tu reflexes are lightning fast. Tu proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to experto.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description:
Experience enables tu to cast some conjuros more flexibly.

For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú no need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher level than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tu swap out a signature conjuro, puedes replace it with any conjuro tu could have chosen when tu first selected it (i.e., of the same conjuro rank or lower).

Puedes also retrain specificaliado to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normalmente does.

feat->Expert Spellcaster.name: Lanzador de conjuros experto
feat->Expert Spellcaster.description:
bard Tu proficiency ranks for occult conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

druid Tu command of primal forces has deepened, empowering tu conjuros. Tu proficiency ranks for primal conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

Magus Tu fundamental understanding of magic improves, making tu conjuros harder to resist. Tu proficiency ranks for arcane conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

Oracle The intricacy of tu divine power has grown clearer over time. Tu proficiency ranks for divine conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

Psychic Self-reflection has brought tu greater knowledge of yourself and, with it, psychic power. Tu proficiency ranks for occult conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

sorcerer Tu inherent magic responds easily and powerfully to tu command. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs for conjuros of tu bloodline's tradition increase to experto.

Summoner As tu connection to tu eidolon deepens, the power of tu conjuros increases. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs for conjuros of tu eidolon's tradition increase to experto.

Witch Has learned to better control the power tu patron has granted tu. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro attacks and conjuro DCs for tu witch spellcasting increase to experto.

wizard Extended practice of the arcane has improved tu capabilities. Tu proficiency ranks for arcane conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

feat->Enigma.name: Enigma
feat->Enigma.description: Tu muse is a mystery, driving tu to uncover the hidden secrets of the multiverse. If tu muse is una criatura, it might be a dragon or otherworldly being; if a deity, it might be Irori or Nethys. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uVXEZblPRuCyPRua]{Bardic LORE} feat and add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} to tu conjuro repertoire.

feat->Keen Eyes.name: Buen ojo
feat->Keen Eyes.description: Tu eyes are sharp, allowing tu to make out small details about concealed or even invisible criaturas that others might miss. Obtienes a +2 bonificador por circunstancia when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} criaturas a 30 pies o menos of tu. When tu target an opponent that queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from tu or hidden from tu, reduce the DC of the prueba plana to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.

Lizardfolk Defenders.name: Lizardfolk Defenders
Lizardfolk Defenders.description: Estos lizardfolk are from the settlement on the banks of Candlemere; they fight with flails and javelins.

campaignFeature->Swamp Dwellers.name: Swamp Dwellers
campaignFeature->Swamp Dwellers.description: The lizardfolk defenders have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.sdwSrVfu9yG1uwio]{Live off the Land} tactic for free (it does not count against the maximum number of tactics the army can possess), do not treat water or swamp on a battlefield as difficult terrain, and gain a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to Scouting checks attempted in hexes that include swamps or water.

Lizardfolk Warrior.name: Lizardfolk Warrior
Lizardfolk Warrior.publicNotes:
Cuando human scholars speak de antiguo civilizations, ellos normalmente turn su focus a themselves, researching y lecturing en el first human empires. Cuando ellos drift a others, ellos invariably look a cultures que had conflicts o alliances con antiguo humanity. That el culture de el people called lizardfolk often gets ignored o forgotten even by well-meaning researchers es thus no surprise, but a el lizardfolk themselves ello es no matter. They know su history y value su integrity y privacy-si younger ancestries like humanity aren't interested en learning de lizardfolk empires dating back a before el first human knocked two rocks together a make su first campfire, que's fine con them.

El word 'lizardfolk' es un excellent example de humanity's narrow-sighted view de este culture. El name de su people es 'iruxi', but these reptilian humanoides tienen patiently y good-naturedly accepted el name 'lizardfolk' as un variant, y ellos genereunido resist urges a call humans y otro mammalians similarly derivative names en return. Iruxis dwell y thrive en todos tropical y temperate biomes, but ellos son most at home en swamplands, coastal regions, y riverlands, for ellos son talented swimmers, y fish y aquatic plantas make up un grande part de su preferred diets.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: Un lizardfolk warrior puede contener la respiracion for 180 asaltos (18 minutos).

action->Sudden Charge.name: Carga repentina
action->Sudden Charge.description: With a quick sprint, the lizardfolk warrior dashes up to their enemigo and swings. They Zancada or Swim twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of at least one enemigo, they can make a melee Golpe against that enemigo.

action->Terrain Advantage.name: Ventaja De Terreno
action->Terrain Advantage.description: Non-lizardfolk criaturas in difficult terrain and non-lizardfolk criaturas that are in water and lack a swim Velocidad quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the lizardfolk scout.

Locking Alarm.name: Locking Alarm
Locking Alarm.description: Any intentar una open el puerta sin first tracing el symbol de Yhidothrus (un hourglass) en el puerta's face con un fingertip causes un glowing green ward a seal el puerta shut y raise un alarm.
Locking Alarm.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32] (experto) to bypass the magical triggers on the door, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank, counteract DC 29) to counteract the alarm.

action->Lock and Shriek.name: Lock and Shriek
action->Lock and Shriek.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura attempts to open or affect the door

Efecto religious symbol of Yhidothrus glows green on the door, sealing it shut while simultaneously shrieking like a tormented soul. Este howl is audible in areas D1-D4 and is loud enough in area D2 to rouse the bodaks.

While the door remains locked, a @Check[athletics|dc:32] check can Force it Open, or a @Check[thievery|dc:32] check can Pick the Lock. The lock can also be removed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank, counteract DC 29).

Once triggered, the alarm continues to shriek and the door remains locked until the hazard is disabled or the door is destroyed or opened. Tracing Yhidothrus's hourglass-shaped religious symbol on either side of the door with a fingertip disables the alarm and the locking ward.

armor->Padded Armor.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]

Este armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to dano and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort rasgo when worn under heavy armor. Puedes wear just that padded armor or undercoat to sleep in, if tu heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. Este allows tu to keep the armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear tu heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

equipment->Climbing Kit.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.9UJbMaglf35GVzaZ]

Este satchel includes 50 pies of rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow tu to attach yourself to the wall estás Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 pies) but letting tu intentar una @Check[flat|dc:5] siempre que tu criticamente fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

action->Tandem Chop.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura or object within their reach is hit with a Golpe by an aliado using a arma in the axe group

Requisitos logger is holding a arma in the axe group

Efecto logger intenta una Golpe against the same criatura or object. If it hits, combine the dano with the dano from the triggering Golpe for the purpose of Dureza, resistances, and weaknesses. Una criatura or object can only be el objetivo of a single Tandem Chop per turn, regardless of the number of loggers in reach.

M'botuu Frog Riders.name: M'botuu Frog Riders
M'botuu Frog Riders.description: Estos lance-armed boggards from M'botuu and ride giant frogs entrenado for warfare into battle.

campaignFeature->Swamp Charge.name: Swamp Charge
campaignFeature->Swamp Charge.description: If the battlefield includes swamp or water, the M'botuu Frog Riders can start the encounter engaged with a target enemigo army. If they do so, they gain a +1 bonificador por circunstancia on melee Golpes against that army on the first turn of the encounter.

campaignFeature->Chorus of Croaks.name: Chorus of Croaks
campaignFeature->Chorus of Croaks.description: The terrifying croaking that constantly issues from this army of boggards causes all engaged enemigo armies to suffer a -2 penalizador de estado on Morale checks. The M'botuu Frog Riders can use the Taunt tactical action. If they know the Focused Devotion tactic, they treat fallo criticos made when attempting to Taunt as failures instead.

action->Spiteful Command.name: Spiteful comando
action->Spiteful Command.description:
Desencadenante Malgorzata is targeted with an attack or single-target conjuro.

Efecto Malgorzata commands a Gyronna cultist within reach of the triggering criatura to attack la criatura, allowing it to make a melee Golpe after the triggering action resolves its effects.

Mandragora Swarm.name: Mandragora Swarm
Mandragora Swarm.publicNotes:
A mandragora looks like a freshly pulled tuber that has grown into the malformed shape of a child with a grotesque face and hideously bloated body. Estos insidious little plants normalmente form when a mandrake root is watered with a demon's blood. Upon absorbing the otherworldly properties of the demon's blood, the root animates and is forced to seek out blood to feast from, lest it die of thirst.

Always famished and in search for sustenance, mandragoras live haunted, pained lives and perform vile and desperate acts to acquire the blood they crave. While they prefer magicaliado infused blood such as that of unicorns, fey, or sorcerers, and they can also feed off of potions, alchemical bombs, and other magical elixirs, a mandragora can subsist on the blood of non-magical criaturas. They find the flavor of mundane blood to be bland and bitter, and they do not blanch at voicing these complaints to la criaturas from which they drink.

While the typical mandragora is the size of a human child, some of these evil plants continue to grow and grow, reaching sizes more comparable to those of giants. Sometimes as they grow, they form additional limbs or rudimentary faces, eventualiado transforming into truly hideous mockeries of the human form.

action->Blood Scent.name: Blood Scent
action->Blood Scent.description: A mandragora can smell criaturas with blood as an imprecise sense at a range of 30 pies, and it can smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 pies.

action->Fast Healing 15.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]
Fast Healing 15

action->Vulnerability to Supernatural Da.name: Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness
action->Vulnerability to Supernatural Da.description: Siempre que a mandragora begins its turn in an area of magical darkness, it queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} on that turn.

action->Blood Drain.name: Blood Drain
action->Blood Drain.description:
Desencadenante Un enemigo sufre dano from the mandragora swarm's Swarming Bites action

Efecto mandragora swarm drains blood from la criatura, dealing [[/r 9d6 #Damage]]{9d6 dano}. If la criatura is a demon, fey, or sorcerer, the mandragora gains Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to the dano dealt. Una criatura that has its blood drained by a mandragora queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

action->Mandragora Swarm Venom.name: Mandragora Swarm Venom
action->Mandragora Swarm Venom.description:
Tirada de salvacion @Check[fortitude|dc:40]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[4d6[poison]] dano and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] dano, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido}, and stupefied 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]] dano, confused, and stupefied 1 (1 asalto)

action->Piercing Shriek.name: Piercing Shriek
action->Piercing Shriek.description:
Frecuencia una vez al dia

Efecto mandragora emits an unsettling shriek. Each non-mandragoruna criatura within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} debe intentar una @Check[will|dc:40] salvacion.

Fallo La criatura queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}.

Fallo crítico La criatura queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}. As long as la criatura remains sickened, this ralentizado condition value no puede be reduced below 1.

action->Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
action->Swarming Bites.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[7d8[piercing]] dano (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic]) and is exposed to mandragora swarm venom. A successful save negates the poison exposure.

Mastiff Of Tindalos.name: Mastiff Of Tindalos
Mastiff Of Tindalos.publicNotes:
Lean and athirst, the hounds of Tindalos are drawn to those who tamper with the flow of time, travel through time, or use magic or rare alchemical drugs to send their thoughts or perception back or forward in time. Powerful spellcasters can draw them from the Dimension of Time via rare rituals, but doing so attracts the hounds' ire, so few who traffic in such rituals live long enough to spread their knowledge. While the hounds possess great cunning and cruel intellect, they rarely Interactuar with other criaturas-other than to hunt and destroy those who have attracted their unblinking attention.

Once a hound catches scent of a mortal to hunt, it calls others of its ilk. The pack then pursues its victim through all space and time until it catches, slays and devours them. Those pursued can escape only by avoiding all angles, as hounds of Tindalos could step through them from nothingness at any time.

action->Otherworldly Mind.description: Siempre que una criatura targets the hound with a mental effect, that criatura takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] dano (@Check[will|dc:33|basic] salvacion). On a fallo critico, it also queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for [[/br 1d4 #Confused Duration]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Ripping Gaze.name: Ripping Gaze
action->Ripping Gaze.description: 30 pies. The hound of Tindalos's eyes glow balefully, causing painful but bloodless wounds to rip open in the body of una criatura that meets its awful gaze. When una criatura ends its turn in the aura's emanation, it takes @Damage[8d6[slashing]] dano (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic]). Una criatura that criticamente succeeds at its save es temporalmente inmune durante 24 horas.

action->Vulnerable to Curved Space.name: Vulnerable to Curved Space
action->Vulnerable to Curved Space.description:
When a hound of Tindalos is not adjacent to a structural angle of 90º (or more acute), its resistance to dano físico is suppressed and it queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}. It no puede recover from this sickened condition, but the condition ends automaticamente once the hound is again adjacent to a suitable angle.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.V60TWjo1G1r5ZtPM]{Efecto: Vulnerable to Curved Space}

action->Angled Entry.name: Angled Entry
action->Angled Entry.description:

Minognos-Ushad.name: Minognos-Ushad
Minognos-Ushad.publicNotes:
A wyvern is a venomous drake with a well-earned reputation for impatience and aggression. As much as 15 pies long and weighing up to 1,000 pounds, a wyvern's resilient body allows it to crash talons-first into large prey without serious risk to itself. A wyvern uses its momentum to stun its target before injecting it with searing venom or carrying it over the side of a nearby cliff. Because a wyvern lacks the strength to haul its prey all the way to its nest intact, it is far more likely to lift and drop its victim over a gully or canyon and let gravity do its work before it descends to pick apart the carcass.

Conversation is of little interest to a wyvern, as la criatura normalmente speaks only to taunt its prey, issue territorial claims, or demand tribute. Even so, many wyverns enjoy grim humor and tales of violent acts, particularly if those acts were committed by the storyteller. A wyvern properly appeased with meat, entertainment, and treasure sometimes agrees to provide assistance ranging from giving directions to serving as a mount for a powerful humanoid. However, these arrangements rarely last more than a few weeks before the wyvern's pride, malice, or insolence inspires it to flee or even betray its aliados. Only the truly cruel can cow a wyvern into servitude for an extended period, as most wyverns are so self-interested that they go out of their way to avoid helping others.

Ravenous, bestial, and driven by instinct-drakes are primitive draconic monsters who bear a fraction of the terrifying might of their larger cousins but little (if any) of the cunning. While they're weaker, slower, and less inclined toward reason than dragons, drakes are nonetheless a menace to criaturas and settlements around them. Their propensity for forming raiding parties-small social groups fittingly called "rampages"-makes them all the more dangerous; a single rampage of river drakes can quickly lay waste to a waterside village, and roving rampages of desert drakes are a plague to caravan traders.

Drakes share a number of physical characteristics that unite them as one species despite their wide variety of habitats and abilities. For example, drakes lack forearms, leaving them only their formidable jaws and thick-scaled tails with which to attack if engaged at melee range. Most drakes would rather avoid close combat, however, preferring to use their breath armas to wreak havoc in wide swaths from comfortable distances while flying overhead. Finalmente, all drakes have small reservoirs of their ancestral draconic power that they can tap into to perform incredible feats of speed.

Ngara.name: Ngara
Ngara.publicNotes:
In naga culture, the foul-tempered, unkempt spirit naga holds a contemptible place similar to that of hags in humanoid cultures. Estos decrepit criaturas live out lives of solitude, sought out only by those who are foolish or brave enough to think they can benefit from the spirit naga's powers without paying a heavy price-for most who dare to show such hubris, the price is their own lives.

Spirit nagas seek out desolate ruins and places long associated with death and corruption. Estos sinister, serpentine beings can be found in abandoned graveyards, crumbled fortresses, rotting swamps, and blighted woodlands. Though they may know little of the actual history of such places, the nagas are nonetheless attracted to the psychic remnants of evil deeds and tormented spirits that remain within the earth and stones there.

Despite their hideous appearance and treatment as pariahs by other nagas, spirit nagas feel a profound pride in their abilities and even in their hermetic existences. They see themselves as connected to a greater force whose mysteries are revealed only to those who can cast off the trappings and morals of "civilized" SOCIETY. Even so, spirit nagas gleefully accept the worship of other criaturas willing to bow to their capricious whims. They often form cults around themselves, using their charm conjuros and rituals to ensnare the minds of a few key individuals who spread the nagas' foul influence throughout a community.

Nagas are identifiable by their serpentine bodies and strange, humanlike heads. All nagas have magical abilities and great INTELLIGENCE, which they combine to advance their own agendas.

Nightmare Rook.hpDetails: regeneration 20 (desactivada por cold iron or lawful)
Nightmare Rook.publicNotes:
Legendarily massive raptors capable of carrying off elephants as prey, rocs are normalmente about 30 pies long from beak to tail and have a wingspan of 80 pies or more. While their beaks are hooked to rip flesh from bone, their hunting strategy involves grabbing their prey in their powerful talons and then dropping it from great heights before feeding. Este method creates a massive amount of carrion, which guarantees that rocs are followed by flocks of opportunistic scavengers, such as ravens and buzzards, who find it easy to steal bits of the larger birds' meals. Rocs, for the most part, no mind these criaturas, which sometimes get gobbled up along with the rest of the roc's food.

Rocs normalmente nest among mountaintops and cliffs inaccessible to all but the bravest of terrestrial dwellers. They are long-range predators that hunt both land and sea in search for massive prey to sustain them and their young. Rocs are antisocial and lone hunters who compete with each other in fierce aerial battles to protect territory. But about once a decade, a mating couple pairs up to raise their chicks. Once the chicks are old enough to hunt on their own, the parents separate to once again engage in lone hunting.

Particularly skilled druids or rangers might capture and train a roc to serve as a flying mount or hunting companion, though examples of such an incredible feat of domestication are few and far between. The easiest way to rear a roc is to do so from the moment it hatches, since the chick imprints on the first criatura it sees. Acquiring a roc egg is by no means an easy feat, though, and is often a death sentence for the would-be egg-snatcher.

harmed by acid ([[/r {9d10}]]{9d10 dano}, [[/r {2d10}]]{2d10 dano} from areas or dano persistente); healed by fire (area [[/r 2d10[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by electricity

A golem is immune to conjuros and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. Estos exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of dano (this dano has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the dano listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condition and gain PG equal to half the dano the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the PG listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's ralentizado 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Numerian Construct.name: Numerian Construct
action->Numerian Construct.description:
Any encounters with adamantine golems, guthallaths, or radiant wardens in Numeria are with ancient robotic versions of these criaturas. In encounters with them, describe them as having more technological aspects. The guthallath's erosion aura could be caused by clouds of deconstructor nanites and its annihilation beams manifest as plasma blasts. The adamantine golem might have tank treads instead of legs and its vent ability might manifest as a spray of dozens of laser beams in a cone. And the radiant warden's radiant beams and blast serve as rippling attacks of focused graviton beams.

All of these constructs have weakness 15 to critical hits and electricity, but their other statistics do not change. If tu'd rather not introduce Numeria's themes of super-science and strange technology, puedes either present these constructs as standard versions, or re-roll tu encounter to get a more appropriate result for tu game.

action->Repair Mode.name: Repair Mode

Once it has more than 30 PG, it can use any type of action and can use reactions, though it remains ralentizado 1 and no puede take any reactions until el comienzo de su siguiente turno.

If a impacto critico with an adamantine @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal} arma reduces the golem to 0 PG, or if such a arma hits it while it's already at 0 PG, then the golem is destroyed.

action->Vulnerable to Dispelling.name: Vulnerable to Dispelling

The golem can be targeted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}.

If targeted by such a conjuro of 9th level or higher, the golem has its resistance to dano físico lowered to 15 and queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} if in REPAIR mode) for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}. During this time, if the golem is reduced to 0 PG while already in REPAIR mode, it is destroyed.

Nyrissa.name: Nyrissa
Nyrissa.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Nyrissa.publicNotes:
Nyrissa tiene no always been un power en el First World, but cuando ella fell en love con Count Ranalc, one de el realm's Eldest, ella challenged su place en el plane's hierarchy. El lovers inspired cada otro a increasing acts de audacity, y ello wasn't long before Nyrissa began a think de herself as el newest de el Eldest y proclaimed este a cualquier who would listen, beginning a build su own nation en el First World. Another de el Eldest, el Lantern King, saw opportunity for mayhem here. He spread su influence among su fellow demigods, y before long, several among el Eldest opposed Nyrissa's claim y took da pasos a challenge su. First, ellos sent un jabberwock a destruir su, but Nyrissa defeated ello y used su sangre a create menor jabberwocks under su own control. Then ellos attempted a reunido un thousand powerful fey against su, but Nyrissa convinced those fey a serve su instead en return for un place en su domain. Finalmente, el Eldest exiled Count Ranalc a el Shadow Plane for helping a cause el problem en el first place. Suddenly, Nyrissa found herself sin un aliado among el Eldest. Having expended much de su energy y resources a defeat el jabberwock y recruit el thousand, ella knew que ella had lost el war y surrendered, apologizing for su acts.

El Lantern King decided que Nyrissa's apology would suffice solo for el jabberwock's death; for su otro deeds, el demanded un further punishment- Nyrissa's capacity a love. Without love, el Lantern King argued a el otro Eldest, Nyrissa would no be able a sway another de them a su side. However, si ella could replace el "thousand fey breaths" ella stole de el First World con un thousand stolen nations, ellos would accept su apology for su otro actions y restore su capacity a love. Faced con no real option, Nyrissa agreed. She fue allowed a keep su domain, now known as Thousandbreaths, but ello fue carved off a form su own demiplane a serve as un sort de prison. Her love fue taken de su y transformed into el sword Briar, que fue then entrusted a el Lantern King for safekeeping. He gifted Nyrissa con un chalice el called el Apology, un artifact capable de transforming Material Plane kingdoms ella conquered into motes de sand. Once el Apology held un thousand motes de sand, those lands would be absorbed into el First World, Nyrissa would be forgiven, y love would be restored a su.

El matter settled, el Eldest quickly moved en con su own inscrutable agendas. Yet mientras ellos eventualiado forget about what ellos'd done a Nyrissa, el nymph herself did no. She grew more y more obsessed con su loss de love-o perhaps ello fue el loss de love que caused su a grow more violent y obsessed. In su early intenta una discover el location de Briar, ella received el visions que would come a haunt su-que Briar would be returned a su, but solo as un instrument de su own death.

Now ella tiene but one kingdom left a claim: el nuevo kingdom risen en el Stolen Lands. With el War de el River Kings over y one kingdom un victor, el time es right for el final grain a be added a el Apology. That este va a destruir un significant region en Golarion es irrelevant a el loveless nymph; en su obsession, ella fails a see que este act puede be el very thing que drives su enemigos de a slay su as en el vision.

Nyrissa's Tempest.name: Nyrissa's Tempest
Nyrissa's Tempest.description: Sudden dark clouds gather en el sky above, y moments later, blasts de lightning y swirling tornadoes begin a rip el landscape apart.
Nyrissa's Tempest.disable: @Check[nature|dc:42] (maestro) to note the magical NATURE of the storm and to perform a quick ritual and prayer to the fey spirits of the region to cause the tempest to disperse, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank, counteract DC 36) to counteract the tempest immediately.
Nyrissa's Tempest.routine:
(4 actions) If the PCs successfully sought shelter with a Supervivencia check, the storm takes no actions if the GM fails a @Check[flat|dc:16]. Otherwise, the storm takes four of the following actions, each determined by rolling a [[/br 1d4]], during the round. On each successive round, the number of actions the storm takes is reduced by 1; when the storm is reduced to 0 actions in this way, the hazard ends.

  • 1 Thunderclap A blast of sound rips through the region. Unsheltered armies debe intentar una DC 30 Morale check or increase their shaken value by 1. Unsheltered PCs take @Damage[10d6[sonic]] dano (@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic]).
  • 2 Lightning The tempest takes its Raging Storm reaction as a single action.
  • 3 Tornado A tornado funnel extends down from the storm to unerringly strike at a PC, who debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:38] salvacion.

Éxito crítico The PC escapes unscathed.

Éxito The PC is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} and takes @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] dano.

Fallo The PC is hurled through the air, taking @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] dano and then falling 1d6×10 pies for appropriate falling dano, landing prone.

Fallo crítico Como un fallo, but @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] dano and a fall of [[/r 10*(2d8) #Feet Fallen]]{2d8 x 10 pies}.

  • 4 Renewal Blasts of wind tear through the area but do no real dano. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]; con un exito, the number of actions the storm takes el siguiente asalto is not reduced as usual.

action->Raging Storm.name: Raging Storm
action->Raging Storm.description:
Desencadenante PCs fail an attempt to Disable the tempest, or 10 minutos pass without any attempt to leave the area (whichever comes first)

Efecto Bolts of lightning lance down from above. If the PCs managed to succeed at a Supervivencia check to prepare for the storm, their armies are protected and only one PC (determined randomly) is targeted by this bolt, otherwise all PCs and armies are targeted by bolts. Against PCs, the bolt inflicts @Damage[10d6[electricity]] dano (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]). Against armies, the bolt inflicts 1 point of dano (DC 30 Mobility check negates). Then, whether or not the PCs managed to take shelter, roll initiative for Nyrissa's Tempest.

Overgrown Viper Vine.name: Overgrown Viper Vine
Overgrown Viper Vine.publicNotes:
A voracious, flesh-eating carnivore, the viper vine has a single enormous blossom arising from a thick, leafy tangle of snake-like vines. When the plant senses the approach of suitable prey through its sensitive, shallowly buried root system, it rises up like an agitated snake and unfurls its brightly colored bloom, an act that releases a cloud of mind-numbing pollen. Persistent stories claim the viper vine can lure prey into its clutches by swaying with a hypnotic motion, but este efecto is in fact created by this invisible, odorless pollen cloud.

Since a viper vine gains nourishment by consuming criaturas rather than through ingesting moisture and soil, it has developed rudimentary locomotion and can drag itself along the ground with its tentacle-like roots. It even has a form of rudimentary sentience, allowing it to not only discern differences in prey and make limited tactical decisions, but also to avoid criaturas that are particularly large or dangerous-looking.

The area around viper vine hunting grounds is often strewn with the partialiado devoured remains of victims. It's not unusual to find the rotting corpses of wild animals, ill-fated adventurers, and even giants in the plant's immediate vicinity, along with a scattering of incidental treasure left behind on the corpses. A viper vine rarely returns to the carcass of una criatura it killed earlier, preferring to hunt fresh meat.

If a captivated criatura is adjacent to the viper vine, it stays still and no act. It ceases to be fascinated if it's no longer in the pollen aura at el final de its turn.

Wild, hateful, and hungry, it tries to eat any criatura it sees, but sometimes a strong-willed maestro is able to compel a chimera to serve as a guardian or even a mount.

Phomandala.name: Phomandala
Phomandala.publicNotes:
Monstrous humanoids that resemble humans with snakes instead of hair, medusas are best known for their petrifying gazes that-if lingered upon-can permanently transform mortals to stone. Medusas are shrewd and manipulative adversaries who collect and covet secrets, and who use threats and guile to exploit the fears of weaker criaturas. A medusa may seek out powerful magic items, use divination magic to discover secret knowledge and unlock forbidden power, or infiltrate a SOCIETY to beguile influential politicians. Their ability to worm their way into powerful organizations makes them natural leaders of criminal outfits and thieves' guilds, and their interest in magical phenomena leads some to pursue careers as oracles who offer to help adventurers find what they seek-for a price. Of course, if wit and DECEPTION proves insufficient, a medusa can always simply turn rivals into ornate stone decorations with little more than a glare.

Exceptionaliado agile and surprisingly hardy, a medusa rarely backs down from a conflict even when cornered. Many adventurers who thought themselves readied to resist the effects of a medusa's gaze have nevertheless fallen to a medusa, as these criaturas are also often deadly archers able to riddle their enemigos with venom-coated arrows from a distance. Still, a medusa may barter for their life if no alternatives remain, and the secrets carried by these powerful villains often make it more than worth sparing the monster's life.

Prank Workshop Mitflit.name: Prank Workshop Mitflit
Prank Workshop Mitflit.publicNotes:
Mitflits, also known as mites, are self-loathing and pitiful cowards, easily bullied into servitude by other criaturas or even slightly more powerful mitflit leaders. They tame insects, spiders, and other such criaturas to serve as faithful aliados. Mitflits have lost most of their ancestral gremlin magic, leaving these incomplete beings full of doubt and insecurity. Mitflits find companionship in the other base criaturas of the world, and forge bonds of friendship with vermin, the only other beings that seem willing to accept them. A social structure, even one in which they are bullied, partialiado fills the hole within mitflits' personalities, and they rarely rebel or rail out unless their rage hits a breaking point.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life on the Material Plane, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. All gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the lightest and slightest, carefully targeted push from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom gremlins (and many others) derisively call "mites."

Rezatha.name: Rezatha
Rezatha.publicNotes:
A remorhaz is an enormous arctic predator that resembles a multilegged insect with draconic features. Este monster has chitinous plates and more than a score segmented legs, a multipartite maw, and winglike growths fianking its head. The most unusual aspect of la criatura, however, is its internal heat, which burns with such intensity that it causes the armored plates on la criatura's back to become superheated siempre que the beast is agitated.

Remorhazes are carnivores. Their diet includes arctic animals such as elk, but a hungry remorhaz readily devours anything it can catch and kill. It commonly lurks beneath ice or snow and ambushes prey with a sudden upward strike. Many victims die before even knowing what attacked them.

Those who survive the worm's initial onslaught must face not only its deadly jaws, but also its hideously hot body. Este heat can melt armas, scorch armor, and burn flesh-all tactics the remorhaz uses to disable and defeat its enemigos. A remorhaz's internal fire allows it to burrow through ice and snow with ease. It leaves smooth tunnels in its wake as melted ice refreezes to leave the telltale signs of its passage. Most people underestimate a remorhaz's INTELLIGENCE, assuming it to be a mere animal. However, remorhazes are capable of learning languages. Frost giants in particular use this rasgo to form alliances with them. The giants provide food, protection, and shelter for the worm, and in return the remorhaz acts as a guard beast and helps the giants build fortresses and forge metal armas. The giants also employ the worms as war beasts, using them to undermine enemigo positions.

Risen Fetch.publicNotes:
Echoes of the corrupted soul of the undead can be used to spawn a fetch as well. A risen fetch appears more as its source did in life than as an undead.

A fetch is a twisted, deviant simulacrum of a humanoid criatura that exists or existed at one point on the Material Plane. Rumors of fetches that are reflections of entities from other planes persist, but none of these tales speak of fetches that duplicate anything other than a sapient source. A fetch can manifest spontaneously when a powerful criatura undergoes a significant emotional event or dies, either while on the First World or while in an area significantly influenced by the First World, but one can also be created by significant forces like the Eldest in order to torment and vex those who have annoyed them. While a fetch manifests from a soul's "reflection," and as such bears a striking resemblance to that criatura's appearance in life, a fetch has no true memories of its own. It keeps fragments of false remembrances from its source as if it experienced them in a half-remembered dream-which ensure the fetch is enraged by and jealous of its source.

A fetch is similar in appearance to la criatura whose soul spawned it, save that it often displays fey-like features such as pointed ears, plantlike elements, or supernatural grace. A fetch who seeks to impersonate a stillliving source must disguise these features, and takes care to manifest its fetch arma as one known to be wielded by its target.

When a fetch dies, it and its manifested items fades away into a bloom of plant life, its soul instantly recycled into the First World, leaving behind a patch of weeds and thorny flowers roughly in the shape they held in mockery while alive.

River Elasmosaurus.publicNotes:
Elasmosauruses are long-necked, primeval reptiles that dwell in deep oceans and seas. Although not truly a dinosaur, elasmosauruses are often found in similar locations and are similarly titanic criaturas. Keeping their massive bodies underwater, elasmosauruses use their long necks to catch prey and snorkel air to their massive lungs while remaining mostly hidden from the surface above. An elasmosaurus is 30 pies long and weighs 6,000 pounds.

As rare and reclusive as they are, elasmosauruses are sometimes mistaken for even rarer criaturas called water orms, legendario aquatic denizens of remote lakes known for their elusiveness and craftiness. Whereas elasmosauruses are mundane criaturas of animalistic INTELLIGENCE, water orms are magical beings with near-humanoid INTELLIGENCE and a curious fascination with mortals, and they seem to delight in confounding onlookers. As a result, it's theorized that a typical water orm is more than happy to lead a group of spectators to a lost elasmosaurus, both to throw its pursuers off its tail and for the hilarity that will inevitably ensue.

While elasmosauruses are often found in lost worlds and unsettled regions, those who dwell in the oceans of the world do not contain their hunting grounds to specific regions. As a result, it's not unheard of for a wandering specimen to find its way to coastal waters. Those that do often find the ports of small towns or even large cities to be wondrous banquets and are normalmente hunted down by coastal guards or adventurers. When a wayward elasmosaurus like this finds its way into a city's sewer system or reservoirs, though, it can become the stuff of urban legends.

Shambler.name: Broza Movediza
Shambler.publicNotes:
Shamblers are cunning carnivorous plants that resemble heaps of wet, rotting vegetation. Even when standing erect on their stumpy legs, shamblers no have much in the way of identifiable anatomy; they are tangles of parasitic vines that lash out at prey with their longest creepers, entwined together to deliver powerful blows. Sometimes called "shambling mounds," these ambush predators have a particular fondness for flesh, and are most well known for their ability to hunker down and hide in plain sight. A shambler can draw nutrients from plant matter or soil, but won't do so if it suspects meat might soon wander near, and indeed may lie in wait for days in anticipation of such a meal.

Shamblers are normalmente solitary criaturas. Fierce thunderstorms are among the few events that bring numerous shamblers together. During such gatherings, the plants gather around strange but seemingly sacred earthen mounds in remote jungles and swamps and cavort and caper excitedly, stretching their tendrils toward the sky to hope for-or perhaps to summon-intense lightning strikes. Not only are these strange plants unharmed by even the most powerful electrical strikes, but they seem to become supernaturalmente empowered by such bursts of raw energy. Shamblers consider being struck by lightning a sign of divine favor, and those shamblers frequently blasted by bolts of electricity become respected elders among their kind. Shambler elders are few and far between and may possess a wide array of abilities; some can cast primal conjuros, others can empathicaliado call upon the aid of other shamblers in the area, and still others wield awesome powers over electricity.

Other types of shamblers exist, including those composed not of plant matter but fungal growth. Estos criaturas, known as "spore mounds," discharge clouds of toxic spores from their bodies when struck in combat. In semiarid deserts, shambler-like plants called tanglethorns dwell amid sagebrush and rock formations; they resemble bunches of tumbleweeds and cacti and inflict deep, bloody lacerations with their attacks.
