Spirit of Stisshak.name: Spirit of Stisshak
Spirit of Stisshak.publicNotes:
Malevolent balls of colored light, will-o'-wisps haunt lonely marshes and forests where they lure unsuspecting travelers into danger. Will-o'-wisps can vary the color and illumination they shed, and delight in mimicking bobbing lanterns or distant fires to draw lost or disoriented travelers off of safe trails. They can extinguish their illumination entirely to become invisible, and they enjoy doing so once their victims are wholly lost and have realized that the bobbing light in the distance no esta, in fact, leading them to safety. Even invisible, however, a will-o'-wisp rarely ventures far from its target, as it feasts upon the panic and dread felt by its victims.

Beneath its glow, a will-o'-wisp's body is a spongy ball approximately 1 pies in diameter and weighing less than 5 pounds. Although most will-o'-wisps are merely translucent, featureless orbs, gaining definition only in the shifting illumination they create, a few have dark mottling that makes them resemble a skull when viewed closely. Will-o'-wisps have no need for mundane nourishment, and in fact lack the ability to consume matter of any kind; they find all the sustenance they need in the terror of nearby criaturas. For this reason, they like to work alongside undead that produce terror in their victims. Will-o'-wisps are long-lived, if not effectively immortal, and they have good memories. A cowed or defeated will-o'-wisp can be a good source of LORE and information, though acquiring such cooperation from such a sinister monster is no easy feat.

Will-o'-wisps inhabit desolate swamps and forests and are genereunido active at twilight and after dark. They are therefore reluctant to lead victims into immediately fatal areas such as deadfalls, but instead prefer hazards where their victims suffer over a long time, such as pockets of stale or poisonous air, patches of quicksand, and dens of bigger monsters. According to will-o'-wisps, different types of fear have subtle differences in flavor. The lurking dread in the pit of the stomach that gnaws at those who slowly become aware of the fact that they're lost produces a much different taste than the sudden stark terror of imminent death in the face of a towering monster. Because of this, will-o'-wisps try to vary the ways in which they induce terror in their prey, to ensure they no tire of certain flavors of fear.

Storm-Struck Arboreal.name: Storm-Struck Arboreal
Storm-Struck Arboreal.publicNotes:
Arboreal regents-also called treants-are lumbering, solitary criaturas responsible for guarding an entire forest. They take an especialiado long view of affairs and never act brashly or without much deliberation. They ocasionalmente come together in small groups called groves to share news and pass their wisdom down to the arboreal wardens that have sprouted under their watch. In times of grave danger, all the groves in a region may gather for a great months-long meeting to plan and, eventualiado, act upon a threat.

The typical arboreal regent is 30 pies tall, has a trunk 2 pies in diameter, and weighs 4,500 pounds.

Arboreals are guardians of the forest and representatives of the trees. As long-lived as the woods they watch over, arboreals consider themselves parents and shepherds of trees rather than their gardeners. Consequently, while arboreals tend to be slow and methodical, they are terrifyingly swift when forced to fight in defense of the woods. Though they rarely seek out the companionship of short-lived folk-even elves are fugacious in the eyes of arboreals-and have an inherent distrust of change, arboreals have been known to tolerate those who seek to learn from their long-winded, rambling monologues, especialiado if such pupils also express a desire to protect the timberlands. Against those who threaten their realm, such as loggers eager to harvest lumber or settlers aiming to establish croplands or a town, arboreals' wrath is unwavering and devastating. Perhaps ironicaliado, arboreals are gifted at tearing down what others build-a rasgo that serves vengeful members of their kind well.

Talon Peak Roc.name: Talon Peak Roc
Talon Peak Roc.publicNotes:
Legendarily massive raptors capable of carrying off elephants as prey, rocs are normalmente about 30 pies long from beak to tail and have a wingspan of 80 pies or more. While their beaks are hooked to rip flesh from bone, their hunting strategy involves grabbing their prey in their powerful talons and then dropping it from great heights before feeding. Este method creates a massive amount of carrion, which guarantees that rocs are followed by flocks of opportunistic scavengers, such as ravens and buzzards, who find it easy to steal bits of the larger birds' meals. Rocs, for the most part, no mind these criaturas, which sometimes get gobbled up along with the rest of the roc's food.

Rocs normalmente nest among mountaintops and cliffs inaccessible to all but the bravest of terrestrial dwellers. They are long-range predators that hunt both land and sea in search for massive prey to sustain them and their young. Rocs are antisocial and lone hunters who compete with each other in fierce aerial battles to protect territory. But about once a decade, a mating couple pairs up to raise their chicks. Once the chicks are old enough to hunt on their own, the parents separate to once again engage in lone hunting.

Particularly skilled druids or rangers might capture and train a roc to serve as a flying mount or hunting companion, though examples of such an incredible feat of domestication are few and far between. The easiest way to rear a roc is to do so from the moment it hatches, since the chick imprints on the first criatura it sees. Acquiring a roc egg is by no means an easy feat, though, and is often a death sentence for the would-be egg-snatcher.

Tartuccio.publicNotes:
Tartuccio likes a think de himself as having been handpicked by King Irovetti de Pitax en su mission a claim el Stolen Lands for himself, but en fact King Irovetti tiene never met Tartuccio. El gnome grew up en Pitax y, de todos que nation's rulers el'd observed, Irovetti impressed him el most con su admiration de art y style. That el king wasn't very supportive de art styles y pursuits el didn't enjoy never even registered en Tartuccio's mind, as su tastes fueron so similar.

And so Tartuccio set into motion plans a catch el king's attention, so as a quedan first su student, then su trusted advisor, y en time su replacement. He even went as far as a seek out, research, y learn un potent magico technique que allowed him a change shape, intending a usar este newfound supernatural power a adjust su appearance a be something more pleasing a el king's eye cuando el time came a petition a quedan su student. Tartuccio spent meses scouring el rumor mills for opportunities, y cuando el heard de Lady Jamandi's call for heroes a expand into el Stolen Lands, el saw su chance. Tartuccio gathered su supplies y headed east.

Once el events de Chapter 1 play out, Tartuccio es unsettled by el amount de competition el faces. He travels into el Stolen Lands where el's heard rumors de un kobold settlement que's ripe for el taking, usa su ability a change shape a assume el appearance de un unusual purple kobold, y work el Sootscales into un sort de private army el intends en using a wrest control de el PJ' nation just as ellos get started. His hopes de using el PJ' kingdom as un stepping-piedra son threatened by el untimely conflict con el mitflits de el viejo Sycamore, as detailed en Chapter 2.

The Beast.name: The Beast
The Beast.publicNotes:
With the body of a powerful brown bear and the keen senses of an owl, the owlbear is a dangerous territorial predator, fearlessly attacking any criatura that strays into its domain. Those who run afoul of an owlbear hear its terrifying screech only seconds before the massive criatura is upon them, ripping them apart with deadly talons and a powerful beak.

Although their origin is lost to time, owlbears are assumed to be the result of a magical experiment to make a more cunning predator. According to the legend, the wizard was too successful and ended up being the flrst victim of the beast. Today, owlbears can be found around the world, with a variety of features. While the most common subspecies looks like a brown bear with the features of a great horned owl, owlbears from the frozen north might resemble polar bears mixed with snowy owls, and in temperate rain forests they might resemble black bears with the heads of barn owls.

Most owlbears live solitary lives, gathering only to mate and raise cubs, which are hatched from eggs. An owlbear's territory normalmente extends to around 5 miles from its lair, with clear signs of its habitat appearing with 1 milla (clawed up trees, gigantic feathers, and shredded carcasses). The lair of an owlbear rarely holds anything of value, but some adventurers have found trinkets, coins, and even jewelry in the massive pellets of undigested bones these monsters leave behind.

The Dancing Lady.name: The Dancing Lady
The Dancing Lady.publicNotes:
Undeath is rare in the fey realm of the First World, for that plane's infusion with the raw power of life makes undead uncomfortable at best. Yet a few fey have adopted the vile practices and habits of notorious undead while still being living themselves, as seen in the blood-drinking habits of the murderous baobhan sith.

A baobhan sith avoids confrontations when outnumbered, and although territorial, they won't reveal their true NATURE to larger groups. They prefer to drink blood from victims they find attractive, and they avoid drinking blood from animals and beasts entirely, as they consider such activities to be uncultured.

action->Release the Inmost Worm.name: Release the Inmost Worm
action->Release the Inmost Worm.description:
The First Faithful makes fists with both hands, pressing them to their temples so that their outward pointing thumbs extend to the left and right while they cry out in painful religious rapture. The hourglass-shaped scar on their forehead bulges briefly before a bloody worm is expelled from the center of the scar. Este worm shoots through the air to target two criaturas a 30 pies o menos, who must then intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:34] salvacion. The First Faithful no puede Release the Inmost Worm again for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Fallo crítico Como un fallo, but el objetivo also takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] dano. El objetivo remains stupefied 1 as long as the dano mental persists, during which they appear to be aging rapidly. Once the dano persistente ends, la mente del objetivo appearance reverts to normal.

The Horned Hunter.name: The Horned Hunter
The Horned Hunter.publicNotes:
To a satyr, life is a party and everyone is invited. Notorious for their hedonism, these fey believe there's no greater beauty than can be found in song, drink, indulgent meals, and carnal pleasures. Satyrs use their enchanting songs and natural charm to encourage all manner of people to follow their true desires and free themselves from SOCIETY's rules. Este normalmente involves enticing mortals to join raucous parties or engage in trysts in moonlit glades. If a potential companion rejects a satyr's advances, however, the satyr has little interest in continuing a conversation and goes off to find more amenable revelers.

The lifestyle of a satyr leaves no room for ongoing affairs or long-term friends. Once his party is over or his lust is satiated, the satyr disappears back into the forest. The offspring satyrs leave behind are satyrs themselves, and normalmente end up being taken from their cradles by other fey rather than being left in mortals' care. Satyrs are always male.

The untouched beauty of the forest is sacred and precious to a satyr. Brutish intruders who clear-cut trees or massacre animals without eating them risk drawing a satyr's ire. A satyr so provoked uses his conjuros to undermine enemigos and attempts to dispatch them either with brutal ambushes or by leading a rush of forest animals to attack.

Other fey, particularly good fey, look upon satyrs as loutish, embarrassing cousins. They're rarely hostile toward satyrs, but most find them insufferable and advise any mortals they like to steer clear of satyrs' glades.

The Knurly Witch.name: The Knurly Witch
The Knurly Witch.publicNotes:
Annis hags are brutal torturers and murderers, delighting in the musical screams and tasty flesh of young criaturas and those who are pure of heart. Annis hags are the most direct of all hags, engaging in physical combat and using their change shape ability to hunt rather than to infiltrate and betray humanoids. But an Annis hag takes a grisly trophy from each kill and uses it to sow discord, sending the trophy to one of her victim's loved ones in a way that implicates another family member in the murder. Also known as iron hags, annis hags have iron-like yet flexible flesh that resists edged armas, and their own touch is the same cold iron that burns the flesh of other hags. Este allows them to bully their way to the leadership of hag covens.

Malevolent crones who lurk at the edges of civilization, hags use their deceptive, magical abilities to prey upon humanoids, manipulating and corrupting them. Some say hags arose from fey that became twisted by their inner selfishness. Hags gather together in covens for greater power, craft unique magical items known as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ACa9QlFqdmW4s2Th]{Hag Eyes}, and are known to replace infant humanoids with their own offspring-these children quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.RqX0vfUjlycKjGyp]{Changelings} who have the potential to become hags themselves.

The Lonely Warrior.publicNotes:
Jealous guardians of tombs, barrows, and sepulchers, cairn wights normalmente spawn from necromantic rituals. For those mortals who cannot abide the thought of separation from their earthly possessions, the undead existence offered by transformation into a cairn wight can be tempting. Perhaps as frequently, particularly avaricious and wealthy royalty or merchants seek out victims to transform into cairn wights to guard their precious wealth for all time.

Only in the rarest instances is the greed of a mortal strong enough to spontaneously transform them into a cairn wight without a dark ritual or the intercession of a powerful divine being. On those occasions, however, the resultant wight exhibits unmatched viciousness and likely owns rare treasure indeed.

As guardians of material possessions, cairn wights are supernaturalmente bound to the armaments they wore during the ritual used to create them. They can spread their necromantic powers into the armas they wield. A slash from a cairn wight's sword channels life from the victim into the wight.

The Misbegotten Troll.name: The Misbegotten Troll
The Misbegotten Troll.publicNotes:
Some trolls have learned the skills necessary to survive well beyond the typical life expectancy for their kind and reunido others to follow their lead. Estos champions develop a number of talents that make them worthy leaders and potent hunters-namely their abilities to willingly boost the rate of their regeneration and to shake off the acid and fire that would hinder it, not to mention a bestial roar that can send would-be predators scurrying off. Troll kings possess a cunning far beyond their younger kin- they know to keep their aliados close, and their enemigos even closer. If a troll king so much as suspects that one of its followers is plotting to usurp it, retribution is swift and fatal.

Slavering, cruel, practicamente invincible brutes: this is the villager's stock description for the dread monsters known as trolls. But words hardly do justice to trolls' capacity for destruction. They are as bloodthirsty as orcs but lacking the discipline, as massive as giants but capable of regenerating wounded flesh in an instant, and as reprobate as ogres but with twice the strength. The only way to realmente understand the wanton violence of a troll is to experience it firsthand-a fate few would wish even upon their worst enemigos.

The first thing that comes to mind when most think of trolls is la criaturas' power of bodily regeneration. So potent is this regeneration that the only way to overcome it is to exploit the troll's vulnerability to acid and fire. It is not enough to slay the troll with caustic or flaming armas, though-even the smallest scrap of a troll's flesh can regenerate into a full-size troll given enough time. The only sure way to eradicate a troll menace is to burn the monster's entire body until nothing remains.

Trolls are solitary hunters, for their wickedness is anathema even to other giants. They ocasionalmente roam in small gangs of two to four, but only when prey is plentiful or a particularly strong counterforce has broached their hunting grounds. In rare instances, an old and powerful troll comes to lead small tribes of trolls. Such "troll kings" possess enough cunning to lead their hordes in devastating raids and massacres, and their presence permanently alters the surrounding ecosystem. A wide variety of trolls exist, from the terrible monster tradicionalmente associated with the name to the water-dwelling scrag and hybrid flood troll. Regional variations exist as well-mountain trolls among stony peaks, for instance, or moss trolls in swampy bayous-but all share the same trademark regenerative powers and insatiable thirst for blood.

(3 actions; divine, enchantment, mental) Ghostly images of chanting dwarves float through the room, drifting between la criaturas in the chamber. As they float, they use their 3 actions to target up to three different criaturas in the room, touching their brows and filling that person's head with overwhelming but entirely mental choirs exalting the glory of Torag. spell->Veil.name: Veil
spell->Veil.description:
Tú disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape and roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro no change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tú elige the disguise for each target; for example, tu could make one target appear to be a dwarf and another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, and it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.34DA4rFy7bduRAld]

Though it appears to be a cloth sack decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a bag of holding opens into an extradimensional space larger than its outside dimensions. The Volumen held inside the bag no change the Volumen of the bag of holding itself. The amount of Volumen the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

Puedes Interactuar with the bag of holding to put items in or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A criatura viva placed inside the bag has enough air durante 10 minutos before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag no puede be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

action->Discorporate.name: Discorporate
action->Discorporate.description:
When the worm that walks is reduced to 0 PG, it discorporates and the component worms that make up its body disperse in every direction. If even a single worm escapes, the worm that walks will eventualiado re-form using a process that normalmente takes [[/gmr 1d10 #Re-Form]]{1d10 days}.

While the exact circumstances and surroundings determine how long the worm that walks's enemigos have to dispatch the fleeing worms before they escape, normalmente its enemigos have only a single round. Typicaliado, this requires the application of an area effect or splash arma within 1 asalto to the space where the worm that walks collapsed. After any amount of area or dano de salpicadura is dealt to that space, the character dealing the dano debe intentar una @Check[flat|dc:15] check. Each subsequent area or dano de salpicadura effect performed on the area reduces the DC of this prueba plana by 2, to a minimum of DC 5. If any of these flat checks succeed, none of the worms escape, and the worm that walks is destroyed permanently.

At the GM's discretion, clever means of trapping or otherwise detaining the vermin may extend the time allowed to finish off the worm that walks.

action->Unseen Sight.description: The removal of the eyes symbolized a Thresholder's abandonment of all they had seen before, and with the ritual's completion they gain something greater than mere vision: they gain the Unseen Sight. Este is a precise sense that mimics darkvision yet functions even if the eye sockets themselves are covered. More importantly, the unseen sight allows a Thresholder to see the truth of the world, granting them the ability to see things as they actualiado are as if they were under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}, provided they are located within a region under the influence of Yog- Sothoth.

Thylacine.name: Thylacine
Thylacine.publicNotes:
A thylacine can be easily mistaken for a dog or jackal, but the defining stripes on their gold-hued backs and inusualmente wide gaping jaws negate this perception in close encounters. A thylacine is quite vocal, and uses a combination of growls, hisses, and gaping threat-yawns when threatened. An adult thylacine stands 2 pies tall at the shoulder, is 4 pies long (not counting an additional 2 pies of tail) and weighs roughly 50 pounds.

The thylacine is a marsupial carnivore. Este nocturnal predator normalmente hunts alone, only ocasionalmente forming small packs. Because of their odd appearance, thylacines have a far harsher reputation than they probably should, playing a sort of bogeyman role in farming communities.

It gains a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to this INTIMIDATION check, and the attempt is not penalized if el objetivo no puede understand the thylacine.

Tiger Lord Hill Giant (TL2).name: Tiger Lord Hill giant (TL2)
Tiger Lord Hill Giant (TL2).publicNotes:
Selfish and crude, these rough-skinned raiders are bullies and ultimately cowards. Quick-tempered and fond of violence, a hill giant gladly raids and pillages the defenseless but is quick to flee from those who are bigger, stronger, or better organized than they are. A hill giant is never above shoving or tricking one of their own kind to slow down their opponent or get the best loot.

Giants are massive humanoid criaturas who live in remote regions throughout the world. They are divided into a number of subtypes.

Instead, it increases its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.oVhkdym3D6TiTbrN]{Mired} condition value by 1 (or by 2 con un exito critico). An army that is mired as a result of hurled nets can attempt to reduce the value of this mired condition (but not that caused by other sources) by attempting a Battle action against the Tok-Nikrat Scout's Maneuver DC. Con un exito, the army reduces their mired condition by 1 (or by 2 con un exito critico), but con un fallo critico, they increase the mired condition caused by the hurled nets by 1. Tok-Nikrat Scouts no puede hurl nets at a target army that is distant.

feat->Deity (Sarenrae).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tu revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits tu get for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tu the rango de competencia entrenado in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tu also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normalmente on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tu prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tu select a doctrine and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tu initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentalmente opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tu from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity no esta limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tu and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tu perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tu lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tu lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tu demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or its counterforce, void energy. When tu prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tu elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.AvNbdGSOTWNRgcxs]
Divine Spellcasting (clérigo)
feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tu the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes normalmente hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tu until tu cast them or until tu prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemigos to roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvacion). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

deity->Sarenrae.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]

Sarenrae is one of the most popular deities on Golarion by virtue of her association with the life-giving sun and her perpetual offer to help anyone be their best, even when they have made mistakes. Most people thank her for her kind work to channel the sun's power for everyone's safety and livelihood, and thank her clergy for granting her healing power to all who need it. Mortals look to the Dawnflower as an example of boundless love, exquisite kindness, and true patience. They pray to her to heal the sick, lift up the downtrodden, and illuminate darkness of circumstance as well as darkness of spirit. Her followers aspire to emulate her through generosity, nurturing, truthfulness, and selfless courage. They oppose evil everywhere with words first, and when necessary, with scimitar and flame.

Edicts destroy the Spawn of Rovagug, protect aliados, provide aid to the sick and wounded, seek and allow redemption

Anathema create undead, lie, deny a repentant criatura an opportunity for redemption, fail to strike down evil

Areas of Concern healing, honesty, redemption, and the sun

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tu the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes normalmente hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tu until tu cast them or until tu prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemigos to roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvacion). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

Troll Guard.name: Troll Guard
Troll Guard.publicNotes:
Some trolls have learned the skills necessary to survive well beyond the typical life expectancy for their kind and reunido others to follow their lead. Estos champions develop a number of talents that make them worthy leaders and potent hunters-namely their abilities to willingly boost the rate of their regeneration and to shake off the acid and fire that would hinder it, not to mention a bestial roar that can send would-be predators scurrying off. Troll kings possess a cunning far beyond their younger kin- they know to keep their aliados close, and their enemigos even closer. If a troll king so much as suspects that one of its followers is plotting to usurp it, retribution is swift and fatal.

Slavering, cruel, practicamente invincible brutes: this is the villager's stock description for the dread monsters known as trolls. But words hardly do justice to trolls' capacity for destruction. They are as bloodthirsty as orcs but lacking the discipline, as massive as giants but capable of regenerating wounded flesh in an instant, and as reprobate as ogres but with twice the strength. The only way to realmente understand the wanton violence of a troll is to experience it firsthand-a fate few would wish even upon their worst enemigos.

The first thing that comes to mind when most think of trolls is la criaturas' power of bodily regeneration. So potent is this regeneration that the only way to overcome it is to exploit the troll's vulnerability to acid and fire. It is not enough to slay the troll with caustic or flaming armas, though-even the smallest scrap of a troll's flesh can regenerate into a full-size troll given enough time. The only sure way to eradicate a troll menace is to burn the monster's entire body until nothing remains.

Trolls are solitary hunters, for their wickedness is anathema even to other giants. They ocasionalmente roam in small gangs of two to four, but only when prey is plentiful or a particularly strong counterforce has broached their hunting grounds. In rare instances, an old and powerful troll comes to lead small tribes of trolls. Such "troll kings" possess enough cunning to lead their hordes in devastating raids and massacres, and their presence permanently alters the surrounding ecosystem. A wide variety of trolls exist, from the terrible monster tradicionalmente associated with the name to the water-dwelling scrag and hybrid flood troll. Regional variations exist as well-mountain trolls among stony peaks, for instance, or moss trolls in swampy bayous-but all share the same trademark regenerative powers and insatiable thirst for blood.

Vordakai.name: Vordakai
Vordakai.publicNotes:
At the height of his power well over 10,000 years ago, the original Vordakai was among the most powerful necromancers of the land. When this cyclops tyrant was defeated during the chaos following Earthfall, one of his apprentices claimed his name as well as his greatest treasure, the Oculus of Abaddon. Though he had been the least of the necromancer's apprentices, the new Vordakai was nevertheless a powerful wizard, but it would take more than power to claim the true Vordakai's mantle. Betrayed by followers of the original leader who refused to serve him, the new Vordakai was sealed into his own tomb, and over the passage of eons, the cyclops lich atrophied.

Although much weakened today, Vordakai remains a dangerous opponent who can devastate a poorly prepared party on his own. Don't be afraid to play Vordakai as arrogant criatura-he has existed for longer than most criaturas on Golarion, after all, and if he makes arrogant mistakes (such as neglecting to cast conjuros defensively or provoking Attacks of Opportunity), that not only gives the PCs a chance to survive but also helps to establish the ancient lich as both overconfident and a bit careless from his long period of quiescence. Keep in mind that Vordakai is the most powerful enemigo the PCs have encountered in the Kingmaker Adventure Path thus far, and in defeating him, they will accomplish something truly legendario.

If Vordakai has the chance to prepare for battle before combat, he takes 3 asaltos to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} (choosing an energy type he knows the PCs favor as a result of watching them via his familiar), and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image} just before entering battle. Finalmente, he activates @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} using the Oculus of Abaddon before entering combat (doing so in the first round of a fight if instead he's caught by surprise by the PCs).

Once combat begins, Vordakai starts by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} on the party's strongest healer; if successful, he commands the healer to his side to defend him by attacking anyone who attacks the lich in melee. On subsequent rounds, Vordakai uses ranged magic against the party, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} as soon as he's reduced to 100 Puntos de Golpe or fewer. When facing only one or two enemigos, he prefers to attack with Consume Memories followed by a hand Golpe, opting to save his conjuros for an emergency.

The greatest diminishment of Vordakai's power is represented through the loss of his soul cage-the magical item he inicialmente used to trap his own soul and enable his transformation into a lich in the first place. He cannot create a replacement as long as he remains atrophied, but his arrogance works against him here. Only if he's reduced below 20 Puntos de Golpe does he realize that the PCs have a very good chance to defeat him, and if he survives long enough to take a turn after this realization, he casts his 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to flee to area C5 of his tomb. If he's able to escape in this way, he'll wait for a few days before returning to his tomb, infuriated if the PCs have released his prisoners and robbed him blind. At this point, Vordakai can become a recurring villain in tu campaign!

action->Atrophied Lich.name: Atrophied Lich
action->Atrophied Lich.description:
Sometimes, a lich that remains immobile and insensible for extended periods of time-as Vordakai did after he was imprisoned in his tomb just prior to Earthfall 10,000 years ago-can become atrophied. The exact effects of atrophy vary from lich to lich but always result in a reduction of spellcasting power and dano to their soul cage link.

In Vordakai's case, he has forgotten much arcane LORE and lost a significant amount of his spellcasting ability. At the height of his power, he was a 20th-level wizard, but today, his power has reduced to that of a 12th-level wizard. More troubling to the lich is the fact that he can no longer use a soul cage to rejuvenate-if Vordakai is destroyed, he crumbles to dust, forever dead. Given time, Vordakai could recover his power and regain his rejuvenation ability, but it's unlikely the PCs will give him that chance, as it would take the lich several years to undo the ravages of centuries.

El objetivo debe intentar una @Check[will|dc:32] salvacion, after which it es temporalmente inmune to Consume Memories durante 24 horas.

Werendegar.name: Werendegar
Werendegar.publicNotes:
Gimmerlings are small, shapeshifting fey who stage ambushes to sate their endless hunger and childish greed. Estos cruelly curious fey obsess over finding and making unusual traps and sadistic armas, and their favorite amusement is seeing these traps sprung or the armas wielded. When on the Material Plane, they are frequently found in urban areas, particularly slums or other parts of town where they can either go unnoticed or be easily forgotten-and have plenty of victims to elige from.

A typical gimmerling disguises itself as an endangered child, doing so in hopes of drawing criaturas close enough to rob. The gimmerling puts itself in apparent danger using a trap, construct, or bribed aliado, or even a coerced monster like a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.fWAjkhQ0y50Eh2UR]{Redcap}.

Because gimmerlings sometimes trade obscure smithing or trapping techniques in exchange for gifts that sate their curiosity, their greed, or their hunger, they have at times been worshipped as minor gods of the forge. Some disciplined gimmerlings work as honored artisans, elite guards, or spies for the demigods known as the Eldest who dwell in the depths of the First World.

Whimwyrm.name: Whimwyrm
Whimwyrm.publicNotes:
Whimwyrms are unpredictable dragons native to the caprichosamente dangerous First World. While their coloration and appearance might evoke reactions of adoration, their moods shift quickly from one extreme to the other. Many who have assumed that their adorability and relatively small size equates to safety have met swift and grisly ends on a whimwyrm's fangs or magic.

A whimwyrm is a slender, sleek dragon, not much longer than seven pies from snout to tail, but its speed in combat is unnerving. When a whimwyrm attacks, be it with its fanged mouth or its long tail, it makes several quick, darting snaps or lashes at once. While estilisticamente, these attacks consist of multiple bites or lashings, they still resolve as a single Golpe.

Wild Hunt Archer.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Wild Hunt Archer.publicNotes:
Estos humanoides esbeltos y andróginos tienen orejas puntiagudas, ojos verdes brillantes y cabello que fluye suavemente en todo momento como si lo agitara una brisa ligera. Son cazadores metódicos que disparan sus arcos con precisión sobrenatural.

La caza salvaje es una fuerza feérica implacable que atraviesa el Primer Mundo y el Plano Material en busca de presas dignas. Sus miembros no cazan por necesidad, sino por mandato, orgullo y una idea sobrenatural de justicia o castigo. Una vez que una presa atrae la atención de la caza salvaje, huir rara vez basta; solo la astucia, la fuerza o una negociación extraordinaria pueden apartar a sus cazadores.

The Caceria Salvaje archer Casts a Spell with a range of touch and then makes a ranged Golpe with their living bow. If they hit una criatura with that Golpe, that criatura is also targeted by the conjuro's effects. If the Golpe misses, the conjuro is wasted.

If the Golpe misses, the conjuro is wasted.

action->Living Bow.name: Living Bow
action->Living Bow.description: The Caceria Salvaje archer carries a manifestation of their archery in the form of a living bow. Este arma functions as a +2 greater striking frost composite longbow as long as it is wielded by the Caceria Salvaje archer, but in any other criatura's hands the living bow functions as a normal, nonmagic composite longbow. A Caceria Salvaje archer can manifest a replacement living bow if its previous one is lost or destroyed by performing a one-minute activity that has the rasgo concentracion. A living bow appears to be made of wood and constantly sprouts leaves that turn autumnal colors and drop away; it's bowstring is a glowing green line of energy. A Caceria Salvaje archer spontaneously generates arrows as needed from its quiver when using a living bow.

action->Seeking Shots.name: Seeking Shots

Wild Hunt Horse.name: Caballo de la caza salvaje
Wild Hunt Horse.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Wild Hunt Horse.publicNotes:
Estos corceles se sostienen sobre bocanadas de aire, con crines y colas herbosas ondeando majestuosamente al viento. Cuando no participan en una cacería, los caballos de la caza salvaje disfrutan construyendo recorridos complicados por tierra y cielo y compitiendo entre sí por apuestas siempre cambiantes.

La caza salvaje es una fuerza feérica implacable que atraviesa el Primer Mundo y el Plano Material en busca de presas dignas. Sus miembros no cazan por necesidad, sino por mandato, orgullo y una idea sobrenatural de justicia o castigo. Una vez que una presa atrae la atención de la caza salvaje, huir rara vez basta; solo la astucia, la fuerza o una negociación extraordinaria pueden apartar a sus cazadores.

Éxito crítico La criatura vuelve a la vida como con @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Alzar a los muertos} intensificado a nivel 10, y queda permanentemente inmune a Reencarnacion salvaje de ese monarca de la Caceria Salvaje.

Éxito La criatura no se reencarna y permanece muerta.

Fallo La criatura se reencarna temporalmente como una criatura feerica a eleccion del monarca. La nueva criatura feerica debe ser de un nivel igual o inferior al nivel de la criatura muerta y funciona en todos los aspectos como esa criatura feerica; no conserva ninguna de las aptitudes y solo retazos de los recuerdos o personalidad del personaje reencarnado, y sigue las ordenes del monarca de la Caceria Salvaje. Tras 1 minuto, la criatura feerica reencarnada muere y su cuerpo vuelve a ser el cadaver original, que puede ser devuelto a la vida con normalidad.

Fallo crítico Como un fallo, pero la criatura feerica reencarnada permanece viva hasta que la maten; un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Milagro}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Deseo} o un conjuro o efecto de poder similar tambien puede revertir la reencarnacion.

Wild Hunt Scout.name: Explorador de la caza salvaje
Wild Hunt Scout.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Wild Hunt Scout.publicNotes:
Estos feéricos compactos tienen orejas puntiagudas, ojos verdes y cuernos de carnero. Saborean la oportunidad de vengarse de quienes han agraviado o insultado a la caza salvaje, aunque tienden a aburrirse cuando lo que está en juego no es letal.

La caza salvaje es una fuerza feérica implacable que atraviesa el Primer Mundo y el Plano Material en busca de presas dignas. Sus miembros no cazan por necesidad, sino por mandato, orgullo y una idea sobrenatural de justicia o castigo. Una vez que una presa atrae la atención de la caza salvaje, huir rara vez basta; solo la astucia, la fuerza o una negociación extraordinaria pueden apartar a sus cazadores.

action->Instinctive Cooperation.name: Cooperacion instintiva
action->Instinctive Cooperation.description: El explorador de la Caceria Salvaje automaticamente achieves a exito critico on tiradas de salvacion against effects created by other allied criaturas de la Caceria Salvaje.

action->Wild Gaze.name: Wild Gaze
action->Wild Gaze.description: 30 pies. Those who meet the gaze of a explorador de la Caceria Salvaje come face-to-face with the hunt's fearful power and find it difficult to act in the face of such a legendario legacy. When una criatura ends its turn in the aura, it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:37] salvacion to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} con un fallo critico). action->Befuddle.name: Confundir

If the beam hits, it inflicts ningun dano (nor does it inflict dano de precision from a sneak attack), but it overstimulates la mente del objetivo, causing them to quedar @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} durante 1 asalto. Con un impacto critico, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto.

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: A explorador de la Caceria Salvaje no esta @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado}, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of their level or lower using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w6rMqmGzhUahdnA7]{Surprise Attack}. However, they can still help their aliados flank.

action->Focus Gaze.name: Concentrar mirada
action->Focus Gaze.description: El explorador de la Caceria Salvaje fixes its glare at una criatura it can see a 30 pies o menos. El objetivo debe intentar inmediatamente una salvacion de Voluntad against the Caceria Salvaje hound's wild gaze. If la criatura was already ralentizado by the wild gaze before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} durante 1 asalto. After attempting its save, la criatura es temporalmente inmune to Focus Gaze from any Caceria Salvaje until el comienzo de el explorador de la Caceria Salvaje's siguiente turno.

action->Forceful Focus.name: Forceful Focus
action->Forceful Focus.description:
Requisito El explorador de la Caceria Salvaje cast magic missile el asalto anterior.

Efecto El explorador de la Caceria Salvaje focuses on their mastery of force, standing still as they become swathed in pulsing emerald light. Any magic missile innate conjuros they have cast that day are restored, allowing them to be cast again. Until el final de su siguiente turno, any criatura that sufre dano de fuerza from el explorador de la Caceria Salvaje must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] salvacion or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} con un fallo critico). El explorador de la Caceria Salvaje no puede use forceful focus durante 1 hora.

action->Manifest Crystals.name: Manifest Crystals
action->Manifest Crystals.description: A explorador de la Caceria Salvaje can manifest a +2 greater striking scimitar made of crystalized force or a fist-sized shard of the same in her hands. Estos objects vanish upon el explorador de la Caceria Salvaje's death, or as soon as they no longer possess the items.

Windchaser.publicNotes: Horses serve as mounts and beasts of burden in many societies. They are loyal and normalmente gentle criaturas, and they are invaluable to those looking to travel long distances. La gente de menor tamano, like gnomes and halflings, often utilize ponies as mounts, while horses are the favored steeds for humans and other humanoides Medianos. Most horses that the average humanoid encounters are domesticated, though large herds of these powerful animals can be found in the wild.

Winged Owlbear.name: Winged Owlbear
Winged Owlbear.publicNotes:
Con el cuerpo de un poderoso oso pardo y los sentidos agudos de un buho, el oso lechuza es un depredador territorial peligroso que ataca sin miedo a cualquier criatura que se adentre en sus dominios. Quienes se cruzan con un oso lechuza oyen su chillido aterrador apenas unos segundos antes de que la enorme criatura se les eche encima, desgarrandolos con garras mortales y un pico poderoso.

Aunque su origen se ha perdido en el tiempo, se cree que los osos lechuza son el resultado de un experimento magico destinado a crear un depredador mas astuto. Segun la leyenda, el mago tuvo demasiado exito y acabo siendo la primera victima de la bestia. Hoy se encuentran osos lechuza por todo el mundo, con rasgos muy variados. Mientras que la subespecie mas comun parece un oso pardo con rasgos de buho real, los osos lechuza del norte helado pueden recordar a osos polares mezclados con buhos nivales, y en selvas templadas pueden parecer osos negros con cabeza de lechuza de campanario.

La mayoria de los osos lechuza viven en solitario y solo se reunen para aparearse y criar a sus cachorros, que nacen de huevos. El territorio de un oso lechuza suele extenderse unas 5 millas desde su guarida, con signos claros de su presencia a 1 milla, como arboles arañados, plumas gigantes y cadaveres desgarrados. La guarida de un oso lechuza rara vez contiene algo de valor, pero algunos aventureros han encontrado baratijas, monedas e incluso joyas en las enormes egagropilas de huesos no digeridos que dejan estos monstruos.

action->Bloodcurdling Screech.name: Chillido espeluznante
action->Bloodcurdling Screech.description:
El oso lechuza emite un chillido ensordecedor que aterroriza a su presa. Cada criatura en una @Template[emanation|distance:80] debe intentar una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:40]. Sin importar el resultado, las criaturas quedan temporalmente inmunes durante 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectada.

Éxito La criatura queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo La criatura queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico La criatura queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} durante 1 asalto y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}.

action->Gnaw.name: Roer
action->Gnaw.description:
Requisitos El oso lechuza tiene una criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrada} con sus garras.

Efecto El oso lechuza intenta destripar a la criatura con un Golpe de pico. Si el Golpe impacta, el objetivo debe intentar una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:40].

Éxito crítico El objetivo no se ve afectado.

Éxito El objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}.

Fallo El objetivo queda indispuesto 1 y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} mientras siga indispuesto.

action->Screeching Advance.name: Screeching Advance
action->Screeching Advance.description: The owlbear makes a Bloodcurdling Screech and Zancadea twice. All criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:80]{80 pies} of the owlbear en cualquier punto de este movimiento are subjected to the effects of Bloodcurdling Screech.

Wyvern Flight.name: Wyvern Flight
Wyvern Flight.description:
Este vuelo de guivernos ha sido entrenado para obedecer ordenes en batalla.

Nota: en Pathfinder: Kingmaker, el Vuelo de guivernos tiene un bonificador de golpe cuerpo a cuerpo de +18. Se ha asumido que es un error y se ha sustituido por +26, el valor por defecto para un ejercito de nivel 12.

campaignFeature->Flight.name: Vuelo
campaignFeature->Flight.description: El Vuelo de guivernos ignora todo terreno dificil terrestre y no puede quedar empantanado por efectos de los que se pueda escapar volando. Cuando usa la accion @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Pu5bptxLrKFyEzFh]{Destrabarse} contra ejercitos que no pueden volar, mejora el resultado de su prueba en un grado. Los ejercitos que carecen de la capacidad de volar sufren un penalizador por circunstancia -2 a las acciones de Avanzar contra un Vuelo de guivernos.

campaignFeature->Wyvern Venom.name: Wyvern Venom
campaignFeature->Wyvern Venom.description:
Un ejercito que sufra dano del ataque cuerpo a cuerpo de un Vuelo de guivernos aumenta en 1 el valor de su condicion @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Agotado}. Si esto hiciera que el ejercito aumentara su condicion agotado por encima de 4, en su lugar sufre 1 punto de dano.

Cada vez que un ejercito recupera Puntos de Golpe durante una batalla, puede intentar una @Check[flat|DC:11]{prueba plana CD 11}; con un exito, deja de sufrir los efectos continuos de Veneno de guiverno, aunque puede volver a verse afectado por un ataque futuro y no reinicia su condicion agotado. Los efectos de Veneno de guiverno tambien terminan en cuanto un ejercito escapa del campo de batalla o cuando termina la batalla.

action->Shyka's Judgement.name: Juicio de Shyka
action->Shyka's Judgement.description:
Xae junta las manos y grita en silvano para pedir a Shyka que juzgue a quienes se atreven a profanar el santuario: "Ayudame, Shyka, para que tu santuario permanezca intacto". Las siete estatuas del perimetro de la sala se animan de pronto y arrojan versiones espectrales de sus mazas con cabeza de reloj de arena al interior, llenando el area A3 con un vortice giratorio de energia azul palido y blanca. Todas las criaturas vivas en el area A3 deben intentar una salvacion de @Check[will|dc:30]. Xae no puede invocar de nuevo el Juicio de Shyka durante [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectada.

Éxito La criatura sufre @Damage[6d6[mental]] de dano.

Fallo La criatura sufre @Damage[12d6[mental]] de dano y queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} mientras su mente lucha con recuerdos que parecen proceder de vidas pasadas y que juzgan sus actos actuales.

Fallo crítico La criatura sufre @Damage[18d6[mental]] de dano y queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} por su lucha mental con esas vidas pasadas llenas de juicio. La criatura tambien sufre @Damage[2d6[persistent,mental]] de dano persistente mental, que termina si abandona el area A3.

action->Twist Time.description:

Fallo La criatura se marchita por un envejecimiento antinatural. Queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2}, y mientras tenga la condicion ralentizado tambien queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}.
